name: Isahaya Ren
source:
Birthplace: Nagasaki Prefecture
Special skills: Dancing, karate
Hobbies: Training
Favorite food: [url=https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Champon]Chanpon[/url]

Member of Kanto's project 47's "Team Passion" who is ranked 2nd between all of the project 47's idols. Despite her cool outlook, she has a very passionate heart. Ren is famous for winning the three previous D.o.Ds, but she always boycotts her centre inauguration despite all of the fame she has received. She also claims to be an artist instead of an idol.
